title: Data Pipelines: Export Content Items to a CSV File | Orchard Core
description:
Teams often need the content of a site in a spreadsheet, for a report or for another system. Copying it by hand is slow, and it has to be repeated whenever the content changes.

A data pipeline reads the content items of a content type, writes them to a CSV file, and saves the file in the media library. You design it in the browser, publish it, and run it whenever you need a fresh file.

In this video:
• How a pipeline chains a source, a file and a destination
• Creating a pipeline in the designer
• Reading the blog posts, choosing their fields and filtering them
• Writing the CSV file and naming its columns
• Saving the file to a folder of the media library
• Publishing the pipeline
• Who can publish and run pipelines
• Running the pipeline and following the run
• Finding the file in the media library
